Dear Sir/Madam, 
Subject: Q2 FY27 Earnings Conference Call Recording 
In continuation to our letter dated September 24, 2026 & October 14, 2026 and pursuant to 
Regulation 30 and 46 read with clause 15 of Para A of Part A of Schedule III of the SEBI (Listing 
obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we hereby wish to inform that the 
Q2 FY27 Earnings Conference Call was held today i.e. Monday, October 19, 2026 at 5:30 P.M. (IST) 
and audio recording of the same is available on Company's website at following link 
https://www.ltts.com/investors/financial-information.
